tasks.title: Fix proof_url sanitize and linkify submission text

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Proof links open correctly. Embedded URLs in text are clickable.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(academic-duties): sanitize proof_url and auto-linkify submission text

tasks.title: Fix split route handlers and duplicate academic duties block in api.ts
tasks.description: Reconstruct orphaned GET /faculty/api-scores and GET /faculty/api-duties/pending handlers. Remove 350-line duplicate v1 block.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Backend build exits 0. No duplicate routes.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(backend): reconstruct split handlers and remove duplicate academic duties block

tasks.title: Fix json_agg null row bug in GET /academic-duties
tasks.description: Add FILTER (WHERE ae.id IS NOT NULL) to json_agg to prevent phantom null assignees.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Duties with no assignees show 0/0, not 1/0.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(backend): add FILTER WHERE to json_agg to prevent null-row phantom assignees

tasks.title: Preserve cycle history before recurring duty reset
tasks.description: Insert into academic_duty_cycle_history before resetting recurring duty on HOD approval.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: After approving a recurring cycle, cycle history is stored and visible to HOD.
tasks.commit_msg: feat(academic-duties): save cycle history before resetting recurring duty

tasks.title: Move ReviewPanel into full-width colspan row
tasks.description: ReviewPanel was inside first <td> breaking table layout. Move it to a separate <tr> spanning all columns.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: ReviewPanel renders in full-width row. Table layout correct.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(academic-duties): move ReviewPanel into full-width colspan row

tasks.title: Profile photo system: auth guards + stale cache + fallback + initials
tasks.description: requireAuth on faculty-profile endpoints, LEFT JOIN photo_url in GET /faculty, TopBar onError fallback, isMountedRef in upload modal, initials .slice(0,2), updatePhotoUrl in onSuccess, photo_url in InspectionModal props.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Profile photos load, update, fall back to initials, and display correctly in all views.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(profile): auth guards, stale cache, photo fallback, initials, updatePhotoUrl

tasks.title: Attendance: Coordinator Excel export and defaulters CSV
tasks.description: ATT-BUG-15: Download Excel button had no onClick. ATT-BUG-16: Defaulters button used window.print(). Fix both to export proper .xlsx files.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Both download buttons export proper .xlsx files.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(attendance): coordinator excel export and defaulters CSV

tasks.title: Attendance: Clash result reset, roster invalidation, reject reason modal
tasks.description: ATT-BUG-11: Stale clash result after save. ATT-BUG-01: saveMutation missing roster invalidation. ATT-BUG-20: Reject reason hardcoded.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Clash clears after save. Roster refreshes after attendance saved. Reject reason modal shows.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(attendance): clash result reset, roster invalidation, reject reason modal

tasks.title: Attendance: Faculty timetable other-faculty filter, hour reset, HOD CSV columns
tasks.description: ATT-BUG-03: rawSubjectTT included other faculty slots. ATT-BUG-04: hour toggles not reset on subject change. ATT-BUG-10: HOD CSV had raw DB columns.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Timetable shows only own slots. Hours reset on subject switch. HOD CSV has clean columns.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(attendance): timetable faculty filter, hour reset, HOD CSV clean columns

tasks.title: Documents: Fix React Fragment key placement
tasks.description: In DocumentsManagementPage.tsx, filtered.map renders <><tr key={doc.id}> — key is on the inner <tr> but the outer Fragment <> has no key, causing React reconciliation warnings. Fix: use <Fragment key={doc.id}><tr>...</tr></Fragment>.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: No React key-on-fragment warnings in console. Table renders correctly.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(documents): move React key from inner tr to outer Fragment in map

tasks.title: Placement: Per-row delete pending state + null guard on top_companies
tasks.description: PL-BUG-01: Shared deleteMutation.isPending disables ALL delete buttons when one is deleting — use a per-row pendingId state. PL-BUG-03: summary.top_companies.length accessed without optional chain — crashes if undefined. Fix: summary?.top_companies?.length > 0.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Only the row being deleted shows spinner/disabled state. No crash when top_companies is absent.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(placement): per-row delete pending state and top_companies null guard

tasks.title: Faculty Leave: Replace prompt() with modal for duty decline reason
tasks.description: LEAVE-BUG-03: prompt() on line ~666 blocks the browser thread and is disallowed in many environments. Replace with a small inline modal that captures the decline reason. LEAVE-BUG-02: dutyResponseMutation.isPending disables ALL duty Accept/Decline buttons — use per-row pendingId.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Decline reason captured via modal, not prompt(). Only the clicked row's buttons disable while mutation is pending.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(leave): replace prompt() with modal for duty decline, per-row pending state

tasks.title: Meeting Log: Per-row delete pending state
tasks.description: MEET-BUG-01: Shared deleteMutation.isPending disables ALL delete buttons when one meeting is being deleted. Use a per-row pendingId state so only the deleting row shows spinner/disabled.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Only the meeting being deleted shows disabled state. Other rows remain interactive.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(meetings): per-row delete pending state in MeetingLogModal
